summary: Add Drawing as a first-class bounded project-question source family while preserving Shop Drawing as Submittal and excluding model-vision narration.
decision_refs: The user requested file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools
The active objective requires accuracy and adaptability across construction content including RFI, Submittal and Email
An offline reproduction proved that a question naming Drawing and Specification recognized only Specification and classified Drawing evidence as OTHER
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and explicit Trunk Tools-style file-grounded question request authorize bounded source coverage improvements.
known_limitations: Drawing classification is conservative and deterministic; it does not infer document type from arbitrary prose or inspect image pixels.
Text-layer/OCR/CAD evidence remains eligible, but MODEL_VISION_OUTPUT and VISION evidence remain excluded from project questions.
The source-family label does not determine drawing applicability, discipline, revision, contractual authority or precedence.
